sentences.en: Hello everyone
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Today we're going to look at another natural food product and that's maple syrup
sentences.zh: 今天我们将探讨另一种天然食品——枫糖浆。

sentences.en: What is this exactly?
sentences.zh: 这究竟是什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, maple syrup looks rather like clear honey, but it's not made by bees; it's produced from the plant fluid – or sap – inside the maple tree and that makes maple syrup a very natural product
sentences.zh: 嗯，枫糖浆看起来很像清澈的蜂蜜，但它并非由蜜蜂酿制；而是从枫树内部的植物汁液（即树液）中提取制成，这使得枫糖浆成为一种非常天然的产品。

sentences.en: Maple syrup is a thick, golden , sweet-tasting liquid that can be bought in bottles or jars and poured onto food such as waffles and ice cream or used in the baking of cakes and pastries
sentences.zh: 枫糖浆是一种浓稠、呈金黄色、味道甘甜的液体，通常以瓶装或罐装形式出售，可淋在华夫饼、冰淇淋等食物上，也可用于蛋糕和糕点的烘焙。

sentences.en: It contains no preservatives or added ingredients, and it provides a healthy alternative to refined sugar
sentences.zh: 它不含防腐剂或任何添加成分，是精制糖的一种健康替代品。

sentences.en: Let's just talk a bit about the maple tree itself, which is where maple syrup comes from
sentences.zh: 我们先简单谈谈枫树本身，因为枫糖浆正是源自这种树木。

sentences.en: So, there are many species of maple tree, and they'll grow without fertilizer in areas where there's plenty of moisture in the soil
sentences.zh: 枫树有多个品种，只要土壤水分充足，它们便无需施肥即可生长。

sentences.en: However, they'll only do this if another important criterion is fulfilled, which is that they must have full or partial sun exposure during the day and very cool nights – and I'll talk more about that in a minute
sentences.zh: 然而，要满足这一条件，还需具备另一项重要标准：即枫树在白天必须接受充分或部分日照，且夜间气温须极低——稍后我将对此作进一步说明。

sentences.en: There are only certain parts of the world that provide all these conditions: one is Canada, and by that, I mean all parts of Canada, and the other is the north-eastern states of North America
sentences.zh: 全球仅有少数地区能同时满足上述所有条件：其一是加拿大（此处指加拿大全境），其二是北美洲东北部各州。

sentences.en: In these areas, the climate suits the trees perfectly
sentences.zh: 在这些地区，气候条件与枫树的生长需求完美契合。

sentences.en: In fact, Canada produces over two-thirds of the world's maple syrup, which is why the five-pointed maple leaf is a Canadian symbol and has featured on the flag since 1964
sentences.zh: 事实上，加拿大生产了全球三分之二以上的枫糖浆，因此五角枫叶成为加拿大的象征，并自1964年起被用作国旗图案。

sentences.en: So how did maple syrup production begin?
sentences.zh: 那么，枫糖浆的生产是如何起源的呢？

sentences.en: Well, long before Europeans settled in these parts of the world, the indigenous communities had started producing maple sugar
sentences.zh: 早在欧洲人定居于这些地区之前，当地原住民社群便已开始制作枫糖。

sentences.en: They bored holes in the trunks of maple trees and used containers made of tree bark to collect the liquid sap as it poured out
sentences.zh: 他们在枫树树干上钻孔，并用树皮制成的容器接取自然流出的树液。

sentences.en: As they were unable to keep the liquid for any length of time – they didn't have storage facilities in those days – they boiled the liquid by placing pieces of rock that had become scorching hot from the sun into the sap
sentences.zh: 由于当时缺乏储存设施，他们无法长期保存这种液体，于是便将经烈日暴晒而灼热的石块投入树液中进行煮沸。

sentences.en: They did this until it turned into sugar, and they were then able to use this to sweeten their food and drinks
sentences.zh: 他们持续这一过程直至液体结晶成糖，随后便可用其为食物和饮品增添甜味。

sentences.en: Since that time, improvements have been made to the process, but it has changed very little overall
sentences.zh: 自那时起，制作工艺虽有所改进，但整体流程变化甚微。

sentences.en: So let's look at the production of maple syrup today
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们来看看当今枫糖浆的生产过程。

sentences.en: Clearly, the maple forests are a valuable resource in many Canadian and North American communities
sentences.zh: 显然，枫树林是加拿大及北美许多社区的重要资源。

sentences.en: The trees have to be well looked after and they cannot be used to make syrup until the trunks reach a diameter of around 25 centimetres
sentences.zh: 枫树需得到妥善养护，且只有当树干直径达到约25厘米时，方可用于熬制枫糖浆。

sentences.en: This can take anything up to 40 years
sentences.zh: 这一过程可能耗时长达40年。

sentences.en: As I've already mentioned, maple trees need the right conditions to grow and also to produce sap
sentences.zh: 正如我先前所提到的，枫树不仅需要适宜的生长条件，还需满足特定环境要求才能分泌树液。

sentences.en: Why is this?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Well, what happens is that during a cold night, the tree absorbs water from the soil, and that rises through the tree's vascular system
sentences.zh: 嗯，实际情况是，在寒冷的夜晚，树木会从土壤中吸收水分，这些水分会通过树木的维管系统向上输送。

sentences.en: But then in the warmer daytime, the change in temperature causes the water to be pushed back down to the bottom of the tree
sentences.zh: 但到了较温暖的白天，温度变化会使水分被推回树干底部。

sentences.en: This continual movement – up and down – leads to the formation of the sap needed for maple syrup production
sentences.zh: 这种持续的上下运动——即水分的上升与下降——促成了枫糖浆生产所需树液的形成。

sentences.en: When the tree is ready, it can be tapped and this involves drilling a small hole into the trunk and inserting a tube into it that ends in a bucket
sentences.zh: 当树木准备就绪时，便可进行采汁作业，这包括在树干上钻一个小孔，并插入一根导管，导管末端连接一个收集桶。

sentences.en: The trees can often take several taps, though the workers take care not to cause any damage to the healthy growth of the tree itself
sentences.zh: 一棵树往往可以安装多个采汁口，不过工人们会小心操作，以免对树木本身的健康生长造成任何损害。

sentences.en: The sap that comes out of the trees consists of 98 percent water and 2 percent sugar and other nutrients
sentences.zh: 从树中流出的树液含有98%的水和2%的糖分及其他营养物质。

sentences.en: It has to be boiled so that much of that water evaporates, and this process has to take place immediately, using what are called evaporators
sentences.zh: 树液必须经过煮沸，使其中大部分水分蒸发；而且这一过程必须立即进行，所用设备称为‘蒸发器’。

sentences.en: These are basically extremely large pans – the sap is poured into these, a fire is built and the pans are then heated until the sap boils
sentences.zh: 这些蒸发器本质上是超大型平底锅——将树液倒入其中，生起火来加热平底锅，直至树液沸腾。

sentences.en: As it does this, the water evaporates, and the syrup begins to form
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，水分逐渐蒸发，枫糖浆开始形成。

sentences.en: The evaporation process creates large quantities of steam , and the sap becomes thicker and denser, and, at just the right moment, when the sap is thick enough to be called maple syrup, the worker removes it from the heat
sentences.zh: 蒸发过程会产生大量蒸汽，树液随之变得越来越浓稠、密度越来越高；当树液达到恰到好处的浓稠度、可被称为枫糖浆时，工人便立即将其从热源上移开。

sentences.en: After this process, something called ‘sugar sand' has to be filtered out as this builds up during the boiling and gives the syrup a cloudy appearance and a slightly gritty taste
sentences.zh: 完成此步骤后，还需过滤掉一种名为‘糖砂’的沉淀物，因为这种物质在熬煮过程中会不断析出，导致糖浆外观浑浊、口感略带颗粒感。

sentences.en: Once this has been done, the syrup is ready to be packaged so that it can be used for a whole variety of products
sentences.zh: 完成过滤后，枫糖浆即可进行包装，以便用于各种产品。

sentences.en: It takes 40 litres of sap to produce one litre of maple syrup so you can get an idea of how much is needed!
sentences.zh: 生产1升枫糖浆需要40升树液，由此你可以想象所需树液量之大！

sentences.en: So that's the basic process
sentences.zh: 以上便是基本的制作流程。

sentences.en: In places like Quebec where …
sentences.zh: 在魁北克等地……
